assembly.title: Assembly
assembly.description: Existing assembly letter ("A"), "EXTRAS" for project-level hardware, or a new key like "NEW1" for an assembly added in this same answer.

qty.title: Qty
qty.description: Assembly quantity, part quantity per assembly, or hardware quantity.

target.title: Target
target.description: For update/remove: the part label ("B2") or hardware name.

item_id.title: Item Id
item_id.description: Catalog item id, copied exactly from the catalog list.

length_mm.title: Length Mm
length_mm.description: Part length in mm (along the grain for sheet parts).

width_mm.title: Width Mm
width_mm.description: Sheet parts only: width in mm.

grain_locked.title: Grain Locked
grain_locked.description: Sheet parts only: true when the grain must run along the length.

unit_price.title: Unit Price
unit_price.description: Hardware not in the catalog: price per unit if known.

AIOp.title: AIOp
AIOp.description: One edit. Flat on purpose: it is also the schema the model fills in.

CuttingSettings-Input.title: CuttingSettings
CuttingSettings-Input.description:
How the shop cuts. Saw widths are separate because sheets are usually cut with a
track/table saw and lumber with a miter or circular saw.

CuttingSettings-Output.title: CuttingSettings
CuttingSettings-Output.description:
How the shop cuts. Saw widths are separate because sheets are usually cut with a
track/table saw and lumber with a miter or circular saw.

EndCutSpec-Input.title: EndCutSpec
EndCutSpec-Input.description: Saw settings for one end of a bar: miter = table rotation, bevel = blade tilt (0 = square).

EndCutSpec-Output.title: EndCutSpec
EndCutSpec-Output.description: Saw settings for one end of a bar: miter = table rotation, bevel = blade tilt (0 = square).

FrameJoint-Input.title: FrameJoint
FrameJoint-Input.description: An override for how the members meeting at a node are cut.

FrameJoint-Output.title: FrameJoint
FrameJoint-Output.description: An override for how the members meeting at a node are cut.

Person.title: Person
Person.description: Someone in a project, as project cards show them.

ProfileSpec-Input.title: ProfileSpec
ProfileSpec-Input.description: Cross-section of a bar. w across, h up, t = wall (tubes, angle, channel). Round: w = h = diameter.

ProfileSpec-Output.title: ProfileSpec
ProfileSpec-Output.description: Cross-section of a bar. w across, h up, t = wall (tubes, angle, channel). Round: w = h = diameter.

SketchArc-Input.title: SketchArc
SketchArc-Input.description: Centre, start and end, counter-clockwise from start to end.

SketchArc-Output.title: SketchArc
SketchArc-Output.description: Centre, start and end, counter-clockwise from start to end.

SketchLink.title: SketchLink
SketchLink.description: A part cut to a line in one of the project's sketches: its length follows the line.
